evidence.claim: Roblox says accounts for users under 13 collect only some non-personal information as defined by COPPA, and that the policy describes how it collects, records, organizes, stores and shares information.

Roblox says it processes personal information to display ads, that personalized advertising is disabled in some privacy modes, and that you can ask it or a third party to disable advertising-related tracking on its websites.
Roblox says personal information collected through its SMS program will not be shared, sold or rented to third parties; a broader sale statement was not established.
Roblox says communication settings let users control who can interact with them, and accounts of users under 13 are automatically set to stronger privacy settings.
Roblox says it maintains a retention policy limiting retention to what is reasonably necessary, and that deleting your account initiates permanent deletion of data in its systems.

Roblox says it processes personal information to display ads (with personalized ads disabled in some privacy modes), applies stronger default privacy settings for under-13 accounts, and deletes data when an account is deleted.

Exodus Privacy static analysis of version 2.739.691 (report dated Sept. 17, 2026) found code signatures for 3 known tracker SDK(s): AppsFlyer (analytics), Backtrace (crash reporting), Google Firebase Analytics (analytics). A signature shows the SDK is present, not what data it sends.
